d: Lowland amena of the village of Lake Secco. On one side baronial palace, on the other inn with sign. In prospect various hills, and other villerecce houses. Folletto among many Villani making games to the bussolotti, Don Simone sitting looking at it with wonder, and Bettina in the act of playing the psaltery.
Donna Lisetta from travel, with Don Martino dressed as an officer.
Don Pistachio dressed pompously with Domestics, and Vassalli followed with memorial in his hand, and said.
Don Simone, in the direction of the traveling Baroness Rosa, followed by Servitors.
Donna Lisetta with follow-up, and said, then Don Pistacchio.

Ameno a thick grove of cypresses and myrtle trees; in the middle of the temple of the Sibilla Cumana, with a simulacrum made like a sun, where you can read some figures artifacts. Folletto, indi Baronessa, then woman Lisetta, after Don Martino, and Don Pistacchio.
